meta.query: Heatmap of trial status by phase for asthma
notes: Phase was judged both groupings; the second is status, the next most likely attribute (p=0.17).
A trial with several phases is counted once per value (once per phase for a Phase 1/2 trial).
923 trials without a phase are not shown.
warnings: Only the 3,000 most recently started of 5,298 trials were read; counts are over that sample, the total is exact.
